sentences.text: The applicant has filed this first application u/S.439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 13.09.2022 by Police Station Dinara, District Shivpuri (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 187/2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 302,
304B, 498A, 34 of IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The allegation against the present applicant-accused is that he along with co-accused persons committed murder of deceased (varsha) who was his sister-in-law (bhabhi) for demand of dowry.
Learned counsel for the applicant/accused argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is under custody since 13.09.2022
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required any more.

sentences.text: Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 23.01.2023 passed in MCRC No. 52980/2022.The
applicant
has been arrayed as an accused on account of memorandum of co-accused Lakhan, who has already been granted bail by the learned trial Court in ST No. 25/2023 vide order dated 09.02.2023.
The case of the present applicant is at parity with co-accused persons.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.) and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds and on the ground of parity, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the bail application and prayed to reject this application.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Looking to the facts & circumstances of the case, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash surety of Rs.10,000/-(Rupees ten thousand only) along with bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, she should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of default, cash surety of Rs. 10,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
In case, if he is found involving in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.
